issues.message: Requirement text is very long (>500 characters). Move examples and edge cases into scenarios, or split it into separate requirements that each state one behavior.

Purpose section is still a placeholder rather than a Purpose anyone wrote (the sentence `openspec archive` writes for a new capability, or a `TBD`/`TODO` marker left in its place). Replace it with what this capability is for, editing the main spec directly: a `## Purpose` in a delta is read only when the capability is created, so it cannot replace this one.
